<subject>Re: Christopher Jackson</subject>
<body>
Most of these terms already appear in the guarantee as waivers—I’m fine repeating them differently if it speeds up the [ORG_1] ore off-take deal. Any pushback?

</body>
<quoted>
-----Original Message-----
From: r420@solbritech.com  
Sent: Friday, 4 July 2025 5:00 PM
To: alexander.huber@tasmanridge.com.au; michael.ochoa@tasmanridge.com.au; melissa.nelson@tasmanridge.com.au; k721@solbritech.com; j401@solbritech.com
Subject: Re: Christopher Jackson

The revised Jackson is acceptable except that I would like to see the first sentence of Section 1 read as follows:

     Subject to the provisions hereof, Guarantor hereby irrevocably and unconditionally guarantees the timely payment when due of the obligations (including, without limitation, all renewals, extensions and modifications thereof, and all interest, fees and other monetary obligations incurred or accrued during the pendency of any bankruptcy, insolvency, receivership or other similar proceeding, regardless of whether allowed or allowable in such proceeding) of Tasman Ridge Resources Ltd to Pilbara Iron Exporters Pty Ltd under the Port Hedland Logistics Accord (the " Obligations").

Please let me know where we are with respect to the Credit Agreement. Are you preparing such an agreement?

-----Original Message-----
From: alexander.huber@tasmanridge.com.au  
Sent: Friday, 4 July 2025 11:42 AM
To: Justin Page; katrina.howell@tasmanridge.com.au; michael.ochoa@tasmanridge.com.au; melissa.nelson@tasmanridge.com.au; Michael
Subject: Christopher Jackson

I have tried to address the points raised during our phone call. Note that some of the rewording in the introductory paragraph is to accommodate documentation that is being proposed by the Rail & Port team here, and which will be distributed shortly.
